O hernie apare când țesutul din abdomen: A hernia occurs when tissue from inside the abdomen pushes through a weak area in the abdominal wall, in the groin or around the belly button.
Poți observa o umflătură care devine mai: You may notice a bulge that becomes more obvious when you cough or strain, sometimes with pressure, discomfort or pain. Its size may change when you lie down.
Consultația urmărește localizarea hernie: The consultation assesses the hernia's location, your symptoms and their effect on daily activities. A physical examination is usually central to diagnosis; an ultrasound may be recommended if the diagnosis is unclear.
În funcție de tipul herniei și de simpto: Depending on the hernia type and symptoms, we discuss monitoring or surgical repair. Surgery may use an open or laparoscopic approach, sometimes with reinforcing mesh. Your general health and any previous operations also inform the choice.
Litiaza biliară înseamnă formarea unor c: Gallstones are stones that form in the gallbladder. They may be found by chance or cause episodes of pain and complications.
Durerea apare frecvent sub coaste, în dr: Pain often occurs under the ribs on the right or in the upper abdomen and may come with nausea or vomiting. Some episodes follow a meal and may last several hours.
Discutăm despre episoadele de durere, in: We review your episodes of pain, previous investigations and other health conditions. An abdominal ultrasound and blood tests help identify gallstones and possible signs of inflammation or bile duct obstruction.
Calculii fără simptome nu necesită întot: Gallstones without symptoms do not always require surgery. If they cause symptoms or complications, gallbladder removal may be recommended, usually by laparoscopy. Suspected stones in the bile ducts may require additional investigations and procedures.
Țesutul hemoroidal face parte din anatom: Haemorrhoidal tissue is part of normal anatomy. Haemorrhoidal disease develops when this tissue enlarges, prolapses or causes symptoms that affect your comfort.
Pot apărea sânge roșu la scaun, mâncărim: Symptoms may include bright red blood with bowel movements, itching, irritation or a lump around the anus. Severe pain can have other causes; bleeding should not automatically be attributed to haemorrhoids.
Consultația proctologică include discuți: A proctology consultation includes a discussion of your symptoms and bowel habits, a local examination and, when indicated, anoscopy. Depending on your circumstances, further investigations may be recommended to rule out other causes of bleeding.
Planul poate începe cu reglarea tranzitu: Treatment may begin with improving bowel habits, adjusting fibre and fluid intake and relieving symptoms. Depending on the stage and response, we discuss outpatient procedures or surgery. An operation is not needed in every case.
Fisura anală este o mică leziune la nive: An anal fissure is a small tear in the lining of the anal canal. It can occur after passing a hard stool or after repeated episodes of diarrhoea.
Se manifestă adesea prin durere ascuțită: It often causes sharp pain during a bowel movement, followed by a burning sensation that may continue afterwards. You may also notice a small amount of bright red blood on toilet paper.
Examinarea urmărește aspectul leziunii,: Assessment considers the tear's appearance, how long symptoms have lasted and possible causes of constipation or diarrhoea. A persistent, recurrent or unusual-looking fissure may need further investigation.
De obicei începem cu măsuri pentru un sc: Treatment usually starts with measures to make stools easier to pass and prescribed topical medication. If healing is delayed, we discuss other options, including procedures or surgery, after assessing the benefits and risks to bowel control.
Fistula perianală este un traiect între: A perianal fistula is a tunnel between the anal canal and the surrounding skin. Pilonidal disease is a separate condition, usually located in the cleft between the buttocks near the tailbone.
Pot apărea secreții repetate, iritație,: Symptoms may include recurring discharge, irritation, pain or a lump that keeps returning. An abscess can cause severe pain, redness and fever and needs prompt assessment.
Examinarea stabilește localizarea și ori: Examination identifies the location and any draining openings. A complex fistula may need imaging, such as an MRI, to assess how the tract relates to the muscles responsible for bowel control.
Un abces poate necesita drenaj. Fistulel: An abscess may need drainage. Perianal fistulas often require surgery, with the technique chosen to protect bowel control. Treatment for pilonidal disease depends on infection and recurrence; some forms without symptoms can be monitored.
Îngrijirea unei plăgi pornește de la cau: Wound care starts with its cause: an injury, an operation or a condition that prevents healing. The dressing is chosen according to the wound's appearance and progress.
O rană care rămâne deschisă, umezește re: A wound that stays open, repeatedly soaks its dressing or becomes more painful needs assessment. Spreading redness, swelling, pus or fever may indicate infection.
Evaluăm dimensiunea și profunzimea plăgi: Assessment considers the wound's size and depth, discharge and surrounding skin. With persistent wounds, we also investigate why healing is slow; further tests and input from other specialties may be needed.
Planul poate include curățarea rănii, în: Care may include cleaning, removal of non-viable tissue when indicated, suitable dressings and regular follow-up. Not every wound needs antibiotics. You receive guidance on care at home and when to return sooner.
